words.ex: Red light has a longer {{BLANK}} than blue.

words.ex: This juice is {{BLANK}} sweet, so I skip it.

words.ex: This disease can cause {{BLANK}} in old people.

words.c: blind(눈먼)+-ness. '~을 못 보는 무지'라는 뜻도 있다.

words.ex: She reads about {{BLANK}} to learn how languages change.

words.ex: She keeps her phone in her {{BLANK}}.
words.tr: 걔는 휴대폰을 핸드백에 넣고 다녀.

words.ex: He chose to {{BLANK}} his parents and stay out.

words.ex: Some soaps still have {{BLANK}} in them.
